Uh... this is just an artifact of the algorithm used to generate the permutations. Change that and you destroy the effect. Also, lexical orders of numbers are not interesting from a mathematical perspective.

The full list in lex order is the numbers from 0 to n^n -1 written in numerical order in base n.

n! of these are permutations of n digits.

The vertical symmetry is no coincidence. Quick proof sketch for arbitrary n below.

Take an arbitrary permutation of n digits, for concreteness say 1908453762. It is the 1908453762th string in the list.

Viewing it as a number in base n (here 10), subtract it from 9999999999 (in general n^n-1, the largest n digit number in base n).

The difference, here 8091546237, is 1908453762 away from the bottom of the list.

And it is a permutation because if a and b are different digits, then so are 9-a and 9-b.
